hierarchy.FlowPassportMembership: Master NFT contract - issues soulbound identity NFTs
hierarchy.FlowPassportRegistry: Central hub - manages all relationships and child NFTs
hierarchy.AcademyCertificationV2: Academy system - creates certificate child NFTs via registry
hierarchy.AssetMarketplaceV2: Marketplace system - creates asset child NFTs via registry

data_flow.exam_completion: AcademyV2 → submits to Registry → creates certificate child NFT
data_flow.asset_purchase: MarketplaceV2 → submits to Registry → creates asset child NFT
data_flow.profile_query: Registry → aggregates data from all contracts

authorization.FlowPassportMembership: Only registry can update reputation and counts
authorization.FlowPassportRegistry: Only authorized contracts can create child NFTs
authorization.AcademyCertificationV2: Authorized in registry to create certificate child NFTs
authorization.AssetMarketplaceV2: Authorized in registry to create asset child NFTs

account_abstraction_flow.step_1: User interacts with any platform feature
account_abstraction_flow.step_2: System checks if user has membership NFT
account_abstraction_flow.step_3: If no membership, auto-creates via Registry.createOrLinkMembership()
account_abstraction_flow.step_4: User action (exam/purchase) creates child NFT linked to membership
account_abstraction_flow.step_5: Reputation score automatically updates based on activity

reputation_system.calculation: automatic via smart contract, updated on each child NFT creation

unified_profile.certificates: Array of certificate child NFT IDs
unified_profile.assets: Array of asset child NFT IDs
unified_profile.child_nft_details: Each child NFT has metadata about the specific achievement/purchase
